_howToEdit: The "Our services" cards, shown in the order listed here. The FIRST TWO get the wider cards, so keep your main jobs at the top. The same list also fills the "What do you need help with?" buttons at the top of the page and the Services links in the footer. title is the card heading; text is the one-line description; points is the checklist on the card; image is the photo path (upload photos to public_html/images/ in cPanel, landscape, about 900 x 620 pixels and under 300 KB); alt describes the photo for blind visitors and Google. icon must be one of: house, hammer, search, storm, wrench, shield, medal, team, clock, check, calendar, camera, image, chat (anything else shows a house). quote must be exactly one of: Roof Replacement, Roof Repair, Roof Inspection, Storm Damage, Maintenance, Other. It picks that service in the estimate form when the visitor taps the button. The earlier stock photos are kept in public_html/images/legacy/: to go back to one, copy the image and alt from that service's _previous block into its image and alt. Put a comma between blocks, but not after the last one. Save the file and reload the website; no rebuild is needed. If the cards go back to the old text, a comma or quote is out of place: paste the file into jsonlint.com to find it.
